workItem.title: Oracle review MIT installed-user observation model

publicContinuityEvidence.role: public feedback signal for the observation cadence, not release proof

excludedBehavior: Windows Docker Desktop Windows-container proof claims
source copying from another product line

comparisonResults.expectedGovernedBehavior: Observation cycles retain public feedback, repeated confusion, video-planning evidence, SemVer candidate opening, Marketplace publication closure, and no-later-than review triggers without treating the cycle as release proof.
comparisonResults.observedMitBehavior: createObservationCycle retains those trigger types, public feedback IDs, due reasons, requirement IDs, and releaseProofAccepted=false.

comparisonResults.expectedGovernedBehavior: Observation facts are classified as observed, deferred, or blocked and remain observation input.
comparisonResults.observedMitBehavior: createObservationFact accepts only observed, deferred, or blocked buckets, retains inputRole=observation-input, releaseProof=false, and proofStatus=not-release-proof.

comparisonResults.expectedGovernedBehavior: Public feedback can trigger observation and routing but cannot prove release readiness by itself.
comparisonResults.observedMitBehavior: Public feedback creates due observation input and rejects releaseProof=true for observation facts.

comparisonResults.expectedGovernedBehavior: Repeated confusion and documentation corrections route into user information or follow-up work, and sustainment-only remains the default unless published package or public-source updates are required.
comparisonResults.observedMitBehavior: createRoutingDecision maps first-run confusion to user documentation plus video planning, defaults informational work to sustainment-only, and escalates documentation/public-source corrections to patch-candidate.

comparisonResults.expectedGovernedBehavior: T014-T016 reporting, command execution, Docker orchestration, Windows Docker Desktop proof promotion, Marketplace publication, and source copying remain blocked until separate admission.
comparisonResults.observedMitBehavior: The merged MIT PR adds only observation model contracts and tests. No blocked execution, proof promotion, Marketplace, or source-copying surface was added.

bugOracleClassification.rationale: The governed requirement, public Spec Kit feature, and MIT clean-room implementation agree for the admitted T009-T013 scope. No shared wrong behavior, single-authority wrong behavior, or ambiguous admitted behavior was observed. Blocked T014-T016 reporting scope remains a successor IAU decision, not a defect candidate.

nextGovernedAction.reason: After the installed-user observation model reaches oracle-reviewed, the highest-scored remaining non-blocked candidate is the public proof-status/oracle reporting surface. It improves cross-authority comparison value without admitting runtime execution, Docker orchestration, Windows Docker Desktop proof claims, or Marketplace behavior.
